design_description: A premium heritage-inspired design built around a sleek black base accented by elegant gold and white detailing. A central double pinstripe runs vertically through the front, while the back features a subtle city skyline along the lower hem, celebrating the team's urban identity without overwhelming the clean composition. Gold-and-white trim on the collar, sleeve cuffs, crest, and oversized player numbering creates a luxurious, cohesive aesthetic inspired by classic football kits. A city bridge illustration on the sleeve and a small EST. 2026 detail below the back collar add distinctive local references, while the rest of the design remains intentionally minimalist. Overall, the jersey feels refined, modern, and prestigious, combining timeless football styling with architectural elements that celebrate the city's skyline and heritage.
